# Anti-pattern: "flat" schema generated without domain context
# Claude optimized for simplicity; the result is technically valid
# but semantically incorrect for the real business

class ProposalSystem(db.Model):
    """Model generated by Claude without enough domain context.
    Mixes business, platform, and analytics data in a single table."""
    __tablename__ = 'proposal_system'  # Generic name without domain meaning

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)

    # Business data — should be in operations_db
    client_name = db.Column(db.String(200))    # No FK to clients table
    proposal_text = db.Column(db.Text)          # Free text without structure
    status = db.Column(db.String(20))           # No enum, any string

    # Platform data — should be in platform_core
    created_by = db.Column(db.String(100))      # Username as text, no FK
    ai_model_used = db.Column(db.String(50))    # No link to LLMServiceConfig

    # Analytics data — should be in analytics_db
    view_count = db.Column(db.Integer, default=0)  # Metric mixed with operational data
    last_viewed = db.Column(db.DateTime)

    # No explicit indexes
    # No soft delete
    # No audit trail
    # No creation/modification timestamps
